summary: Vince Holding Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing that its subsidiary OWL Opco, LLC entered an Asset and Equity Purchase Agreement on August 24, 2026, to acquire all equity of the OVO Companies (October's Very Own), subject to prior asset purchase and debt repayment steps. Authentic Brands Group's affiliate will buy the IP assets, while Vince's subsidiary buys the operating entities free of OVO Debt. No price, premium, or advisor terms were stated. Watch for closing conditions and financing details.
